description: Renders the architecture graph on a Three.js WebGL canvas. ELK computes hierarchical layout. SolidJS GraphCanvas component manages camera state, layout versioning, and annotation overlay positioning. Two layout modes: flat (no grouping) and grouped (ELK compound nodes).
label: Canvas Rendering

members.note: WebGL renderer. Handles node/edge geometry, hit testing, pan/zoom, selection highlights.
SolidJS component. Owns renderer lifecycle, layout effect, camera state persistence.
Dispatches to layoutFlat or layoutGrouped. Returns LayoutResult with positioned nodes, edges, and containers at multiple tiers.
SVG layer over the WebGL canvas. Switches rendering by shape: RegionOverlay, PolylineOverlay, PointOverlay.
Renders region annotations as lasso polygons or bounding-box fallback rectangles.
Renders ordered flow annotations. Prefers live node centres; falls back to drawn stroke when members no longer resolve.
Renders point annotations anchored to a member node or a canvas coordinate.
